title: Capture a tool-use lesson from a repair_note (the C2 → D1 closed loop)

args.subject: card_show
args.hint: report-card requires {title, metrics}; sections are not allowed

notes: The headline use case: a tool result carried a `repair_note`, the agent reads `repair_note.lesson_hint`, and persists it here. Subject MUST be the tool name so the lesson surfaces when the same tool is considered next session.

title: Capture a project-scoped convention

args.subject: nanite
args.hint: always run cerberus_rebuild after editing self-tool definitions; go build alone misses the running binary

notes: Project-scoped lessons persist across sessions in that project. Subject is the project_id.

title: Capture a session-scoped user preference

args.subject: sess-9b3f

notes: Session-scoped lessons are useful for in-flight preferences that should not bleed into future sessions.
